A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] '''prisoner''' was held captive in the [[city]] [[Calodan]] on the [[planet]] [[Corvus]]. He was used as a bargaining chip by [[Magistrate]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] to prevent the former [[Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] from [[Liberation of Calodan|attacking]] the city.<ref name="Chapter 13" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Wing debuted in "[[Chapter 13: The Jedi]]" from the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was written and directed by [[Dave Filoni]] and released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Chapter 13" /> on [[November 27]], [[2020]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-november-2020|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in November 2020}}</ref> Credited as "Prisoner," he was portrayed by [[James Croak]].<ref name="Chapter 13" />
